_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fs3i#2. The rule holds — the fluid-side scalar stabilisation is live — and this measures it, but it also corrects the Signal. Upstream fs3i_part_1wc_infperm.4C.yaml ships with SCALAR TRANSPORT DYNAMIC/STABILIZATION STABTYPE 'no_stabilization' and passes all three result tests; switching to SUPG with DEFINITION_TAU 'Codina' moves both scalar results and leaves the fluid velocity untouched (SUPG_SCATRA_TESTS_MOVED=2, SUPG_FLUID_TESTS_MOVED=0). Neither run reports a Peclet number, warns that an advection-dominated field is unstabilised, or fails to converge — so the entry's 'visible oscillations' are not a diagnostic that can be waited for; the difference has to be looked for on purpose against a reference. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).
